summary: Backend-only re-check of the MarineTraffic scraper fix (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH set automatically to /pw-browsers) and of the older endpoints. All 10 pytest tests passed against the public URL. POST /api/bot/extract-now returned 'Extraction completed' in about 46s. The latest extraction log shows status=success, vessels_count=7175, error=None. Bot status shows a recent last_extraction. /api/vessels total=7175. The backend logs contain no 'Executable doesn't exist' or 'playwright install' errors. GET and POST /api/analytics/schedule work: enabling it fills next_run, and an invalid interval returns 400.

minor.issue: Auto-forward to https://httpbin.org/post fails with SSLEOFError (seen in backend.err.log). Extraction is not affected and this is outside the requested scope.
mt_connected is hardcoded to True, so it says nothing about whether the scraper or browser actually works. The check passes trivially.
The review request says the response has access_token, but it actually returns {token, user}. The frontend may be fine; this is just a doc mismatch.

action_items: Optional: make the fix robust. If PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH is already set externally to a path with no browsers, the fallback is skipped. Also consider running 'playwright install chromium' at startup or in the deploy step, because /pw-browsers may not persist in production.
Optional: compute mt_connected from the status of the last extraction log instead of hardcoding True.
Optional: the auto-forward endpoint (httpbin.org) has an SSL error. Check the forward config.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1617 lines and should be split into routers (auth, vessels, bot, analytics, forward).
POST /api/analytics/schedule takes a raw dict instead of a Pydantic model. A non-integer interval_minutes would raise a 500 from int().
extract-now blocks the HTTP request for about 50s. Consider a background task with status polling.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests triggered one real extraction (7175 vessels). The analytics schedule was set to enabled/60 and then restored to its previous state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_scraper_fix_regression.py. Extraction takes about 46-90s. Login returns 'token', not 'access_token'. Browsers live in /pw-browsers (chromium-1208, headless_shell-1208/1248).
